title: VP Client Solutions Engineering
description:
About Yondr
Yondr is a disruptor. We challenge convention and simplify complexity. A global developer, owner operator and service provider of data centers, we deliver complex data center capacity needs for the world’s largest tech companies. Our exponential growth sees us looking for extraordinary people to help accelerate us towards our vision: a tomorrow without constraints.
But we can’t do this without you.
About The Role
As VP of the Client Solutions team, you will provide technical leadership to pre-sales activities, post-sale activities and customer relationships globally. You will be involved throughout the whole sales process, from the start of a technical solution pitch through ensuring that all technical and design information is correct for contracting purposes. In addition, taking a lead role with Yondr internal teams in all correspondence with the Customer. You will take oversight of the delivery teams’ performance during execution of a lease from a technical compliance and escalations point of view. You'll be required to attend/lead Customer facing meetings to discuss a development’s engineering aspects in support of the opportunity team and conduct expert to expert conversation. You will also work help to drive our market strategy, roduct and innovation.
This role is regional so will require travel globally.
Main Responsibilities
/ 
Take lead in managing technical sales in EMEA and the Americas
/ 
Liaise with technical, delivery, operations and site acquisition stakeholders within Yondr's Hyperscale Customer organsiations.
/ 
Understand and document Customer’s technical requirements, then lead the opportunity design development and present solutions to meet those needs.
/ 
Liaise with internal stakeholders, including Finance, Design and Construction, Operations and Development teams to ensure Yondr delivers the correct solution for the Customer's requirements.
/ 
Serve as primary responder for customer RFPs, including managing the Customer and all internal stakeholders for a complete RFP submission meeting the Customer’s expectations.
/ 
Accountable for the accuracy of the technical content of the lease contract. Responsible for the technical validation of compliance during the delivery phase.
/ 
Support Yondr teams (Design and Construction, Operations, Development) by providing customer insight into future design and location strategies.
/ 
Act as a subject matter expert related to all aspects of Yondr’s design.
/ 
Generate insight and feedback through professional contacts and networking.
/ 
Participate in forecasting, pipeline and market analysis.
/ 
Act as a senior member of the Customer Solutions Team, providing support and guidance to interdepartmental colleagues as and when required.
Qualifications And Experience
/ 
Experience of supporting Customer Solutions teams with capturing and defining the technical requirements and solutions for our target Customers.
/ 
Electrical, Mechanical, Network or Operational datacenter experience. Ideally experience in the Design, Construction and operational lifecycle of data centres.
/ 
Ability to present complex technical solutions in a simplified manner to articulate solutions and benefits to stakeholders with varying degrees of technical knowledge.
/ 
Strong ability to translate customer needs into specific, deliverable requirements.
/ 
Experience of data centre design, business critical infrastructure management and data centre environment awareness.
/ 
Comprehend, analyse, and interpret complex project documents.
/ 
A strong commitment to delivering excellent customer service.
/ 
Ability to learn and apply technical and business concepts quickly.
/ 
Able to facilitate workshop style sessions with customers to extract important aspects of customer requirements.
/ 
Work well under pressure and take a proactive approach.
/ 
Good organisational skills, attention to detail and openness to new ideas and procedures.
/ 
Ability to clearly communicate solutions and the ability to present to audiences from all levels within an organisation.
At Yondr, we want to enhance the diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging of our workforce to reflect the world we live in. Our roles are potential opportunities for everyone; all interested parties, regardless of nationality, race, ethnicity, religion, age, sexual orientation, or gender, are welcome to apply. We ensure all candidates have equitable access and consideration throughout the hiring process.
Yondr is committed to fostering a welcoming, safe and inclusive work environment. We provide support through our benefits, which are inclusive of all backgrounds.

title: VP of Engineering (Spatial Computing)
description: <p>Imvizar is a leader in immersive spatial storytelling, creating powerful real world experiences for global partners including Salesforce, Google, Bupa, Spike Island, Grant Thornton, and the IRFU.</p><p>We are now launching Lureo, the worlds first no code spatial storytelling platform, opening this new creative medium to creators everywhere.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>The Opportunity</strong></p><p><br></p><p>This is a rare chance to join a fast growing startup at a pivotal moment. We are seeking a&nbsp;VP of Engineering (Spatial Computing) who has a proven track record of delivering high quality products at speed and scale. The ideal candidate will bring a deep understanding of spatial computing, gaming technology, and modern web platforms, along with the ability to translate that knowledge into a world class creator experience.</p><p><br></p><p>This is a truly hands on role. You will lead and mentor the engineering team while also writing production level code, setting technical direction, and ensuring excellence across the entire product. Your leadership and expertise will shape the future of Lureo and help define the next generation of spatial storytelling for creators around the world.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Technical Leadership &amp; Strategy: </strong>Develop and execute the engineering roadmap for our no-code spatial storytelling platform.</p><p><strong>Platform Development: </strong>Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of the platform, ensuring performance, scalability, and ease of use.</p><p><strong>Innovation &amp; R&amp;D:</strong> Stay ahead of industry trends in spatial computing, AR/VR/MR, AI-driven content generation, and real-time 3D rendering.</p><p><strong>Team Management &amp; Growth: </strong>Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing engineering team across multiple disciplines (e.g., software engineering, 3D graphics, AI, networking, and user experience).</p><p><strong>Experience Production: </strong>Collaborate closely with creative and content teams to deliver immersive spatial storytelling experiences, ensuring technical feasibility and excellence.</p><p><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration: </strong>Work closely with Product, Design, and Business teams to align technical execution with company goals.</p><p><strong>Quality &amp; Performance:</strong> Establish best practices in software development, including code reviews, testing, security, and deployment processes.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>The ideal candidate will have…</strong></p><p><br></p><ul><li>Proven experience as a senior engineering leader in spatial computing, gaming, AR/VR/MR, or related fields.</li><li>Expertise in real-time 3D graphics, game engines (Unity, Unreal, or WebXR), and immersive interaction design.</li><li>Strong background in architecting and building scalable platforms, ideally in no-code/low-code environments.</li><li>Proficiency in programming languages such as C++, C#, Python, or JavaScript (WebGL, Three.js, etc.).</li><li>Deep understanding of networking, cloud computing, and backend systems that support immersive experiences.</li><li>Experience in Unity, C#, Web development, WebGL, and backend technologies.</li><li>A working style that is highly collaborative and open to working with multidisciplinary teams</li><li>Possess a&nbsp;‘can do’ attitude and strong drive to deliver a world class product</li><li>Experience leading engineering teams, fostering innovation, and scaling technology.</li><li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field</li><li>At least 10 years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5 years of experience managing engineering teams</li><li>Ability to write clean, readable, reusable, and easily maintainable code;</li><li>Experience with source control systems and CI/CD workflows</li><li>Experience integrating 3rd party plugins, SDKs and APIs</li><li>Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment&nbsp;</li><li>Nice to Have:</li><li>Experience with AI-driven content generation and procedural storytelling.</li><li>Familiarity with spatial mapping, SLAM, LiDAR, or computer vision technologies.</li><li>A passion for storytelling, immersive experiences, and democratizing spatial computing.</li><li>What We Offer:</li><li>A unique opportunity to make your mark on the future of spatial storytelling.</li><li>A collaborative and creative work environment with cutting-edge technology.</li><li>Competitive salary, equity options, and benefits.</li><li>Flexible work arrangements, including remote work options.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Compensation&nbsp;</strong></p><p>A competitive salary with the potential to earn equity in the company.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Additional benefits</strong></p><p>Share options</p><p>Flexible working hours</p><p>Training days</p><p>Company events</p><p>Work from home</p><p><br></p><p>PLEASE NOTE: This position is ideally hybrid in Dublin/Ireland and home, however we are open to remote roles for the right candidate.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Next Steps</strong></p><p><br></p><p>Send us a one-pager outlining why you are suitable for the role, along with your CV and relevant links for e.g. LinkedIn profile, website, GitHub or other project links you think might be of interest, to careers@imvizar.com</p><p><br></p><p>The opportunity will remain open until the right candidate is found so we encourage interested applicants to apply as soon as possible.</p><p><br></p><p><u>Please note:</u></p><p>No recruiters, please.&nbsp;</p><p>We receive a high volume of applications, so only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion. Thank you for your understanding and interest.</p><p><br></p><p><em>A culture of creativity is at the core of Imvizar. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion are central to our mission and to our impact. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work. We know that having varied perspectives helps generate better ideas to solve the complex problems of a changing world.</em></p><p><br></p><p>Note: This job will be posted twice (Ireland &amp; UK) due to LinkedIn limitations.</p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><br></p>

title: VP of Platform Engineering
description: <p><strong>VP of Platform Engineering | Fintech | London </strong>(Ideally 1-2 days in London)</p><p><br></p><p>A scaling, global fintech, powering <strong>top-tier e-commerce, payments, and tech brands</strong> is looking for a <strong>VP of Platform Engineering</strong> to lead the next phase of platform maturity.</p><p><br></p><p>This is a senior leadership position it requires a 50:50 balance of:</p><ul><li><strong>deep technical background </strong>in architecting and operating high performance platforms, microservices, API-driven development, and distributed systems.</li><li><strong>leading and developing teams </strong>- the platform team is 20 people. You will lead and foster a high performance culture, reducing silos in and engaging across the business to add value.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>This is your opportunity to:</strong></p><ul><li>Build and scale high-performance, secure, cloud-native infrastructure</li><li>Lead platform architecture, CI/CD, DevOps tooling, observability, and security</li><li>Add value across the whole business taking the DevEx concept and broadening to all internal functions.</li><li>Impact product lines used across 9+ international markets</li><li>Own platform reliability, developer experience, and operational excellence</li><li>Drive a forward-thinking engineering culture focused on velocity and resilience</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>The right candidate will be super focused on the culture and team development, with strong experience of leader (not just managing) in a high growth environment.</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>You'll bring:</strong></p><p>✅ Deep cloud &amp; platform engineering experience (AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC)</p><p>✅ Proven leadership of high-performing platform/infrastructure teams</p><p>✅ A strategic mindset with the ability to scale systems in complex environments</p><p>✅ Experience in high-growth, product-led tech environments (fintech a bonus)</p><p><br></p><p>This is a <strong>mission-critical leadership role</strong> with real impact on growth, scale, and innovation.</p>

title: VP of Product
description: Faria Education Group is a global EdTech SaaS company serving over 10,000 international schools across 155+ countries with innovative solutions designed to empower learners and educators. Our portfolio includes ManageBac, OpenApply, SchoolsBuddy, Atlas, Vectare, and SpotLight Analytics. Our mission is to power education and drive transformative experiences for learners, educators, and families globally. Our vision is to reach every learner and inspire every educator.<br><br>We are seeking an exceptional <strong>VP of Product</strong> to lead product strategy and execution across Faria's integrated suite of educational technology solutions. Reporting to the Chief Technology and Product Officer (CTPO), you will oversee a global product management organization, driving product-market fit, roadmap development, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver transformative outcomes for K-12 educational institutions worldwide.<br><br>This role requires balancing strategic vision with operational excellence - from guiding early-stage products through market validation to optimizing mature platforms serving thousands of schools globally.<br><br><strong>Key Responsibilities<br><br></strong><strong>Strategic Leadership<br><br></strong><ul><li>Define and execute product vision and strategy aligned with Faria's mission to serve international schools and educational institutions globally</li><li>Lead product portfolio management, ensuring optimal resource allocation and strategic prioritization</li><li>Drive product-market fit validation for new offerings and market expansion initiatives</li><li>Analyze competitive landscape across LMS, admissions, analytics, school-to-home, transport, and SIS platforms to inform strategic positioning</li><li>Partner with executive leadership on M&amp;A evaluation, due diligence, and product integration strategies<br><br></li></ul><strong>Organizational Leadership<br><br></strong><ul><li>Build, mentor, and manage a distributed team of product management directors and product managers across multiple regions and time zones</li><li>Establish consistent product management processes, best practices, frameworks, and career development pathways</li><li>Foster a culture of data-driven, commercially focused decision-making and continuous improvement</li><li>Develop the product management team's expertise in K-12 educational workflows, international curricula (IB, Cambridge, etc.), and EdTech business models<br><br></li></ul><strong>Product Execution<br><br></strong><ul><li>Collaborate with the VP of Engineering to ensure seamless product delivery and technical feasibility</li><li>Partner with Regional VPs, Customer Experience leaders, and Support &amp; Implementation leadership to translate market insights into product requirements</li><li>Establish and monitor success metrics, KPIs, and customer outcome measurements across the product portfolio</li><li>Lead stakeholder communication, including board reporting, executive updates, and strategic planning sessions</li><li>Drive cross-sell and upsell opportunities through integrated product experiences<br><br></li></ul><strong>Market &amp; Customer Focus<br><br></strong><ul><li>Maintain a deep understanding of K-12 educational decision-making processes and institutional buying patterns</li><li>Ensure product compliance with global regulatory requirements (GDPR, data residency, EU AI Act, etc.)</li><li>Champion the voice of multiple stakeholders: students, educators, administrators, parents, and IT departments</li><li>Guide Early Adopter Programs and beta initiatives to validate product direction with key customer segments<br><br></li></ul><strong>What Success Looks Like<br><br></strong><ul><li>Clear, validated product roadmaps aligned with business objectives and customer outcomes</li><li>High-performing product management team with strong retention and career progression</li><li>Measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, product adoption, and cross-sell revenue</li><li>Successful launch and scaling of new products</li><li>Strong partnership with Engineering, Global Markets, Customer Experience, and Support, yielding efficient delivery and market fit</li><li>Strategic contributions to M&amp;A evaluation and portfolio optimization decisions<br><br></li></ul><strong>Requirements<br><br></strong><strong>Required<br><br></strong><ul><li>10+ years of product management experience, with 5 years in senior leadership roles overseeing multiple product managers</li><li>Proven track record in B2B SaaS companies, preferably in EdTech or education-adjacent industries</li><li>Strong understanding of K-12 educational workflows, institutional procurement, and multi-stakeholder environments</li><li>Experience managing product portfolios across different maturity stages (growth, optimization, innovation)</li><li>Demonstrated success launching and scaling products in global markets</li><li>Excellent strategic thinking combined with operational execution capabilities</li><li>Outstanding communication skills with the ability to influence C-suite executives, board members, and cross-functional teams</li><li>Experience working with distributed teams and managing across multiple time zones</li><li>Strong written and oral English communication skills<br><br></li></ul><strong>Preferred<br><br></strong><ul><li>Background in international education (IB, Cambridge, or similar curricula)</li><li>Deep expertise in student data privacy, GDPR, FERPA, and education-specific compliance frameworks</li><li>Experience with data analytics, business intelligence, or dashboard-driven products</li><li>Track record in evaluating and integrating acquired products or platforms</li><li>Technical background or strong ability to collaborate with engineering organizations on architectural decisions<br><br></li></ul><strong>DISCRIMINATION DECLARATION<br><br></strong>All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, creed, colour, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or sex.<br><br><strong>Please note:</strong> Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted due to a high volume of applicants.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong><ul><li>Base salary is based on experience, and performance bonuses are based on KPIs</li><li>Monthly Health &amp; Wellness Allowance</li><li>Office lunch &amp; team socials</li><li>Professional Development opportunities</li><li>Unlimited book budget<br><br></li></ul><strong>About Faria Education Group<br><br></strong><em>For over 15 years, Faria Education Group has deeply understood the needs of schools, leveraging extensive experience in education. Our dedication to reaching every learner and inspiring every educator has supported over 10,000 schools and 4 million students across 155 countries. We are committed to driving transformative experiences for learners, educators, and families globally.<br><br></em><em>Our integrated SaaS solutions suite supports all aspects of curriculum management (Atlas), teaching and learning (ManageBac), admissions (OpenApply), and school-to-home communications (SchoolsBuddy). With an unwavering commitment to innovation, our technology meets rigorous data protection and security standards, ensuring first-class training and support.<br><br></em><em>Through our innovative online schools (Pamoja and Wolsey Hall), we provide comprehensive educational experiences with IB Diploma and Cambridge online courses, delivering high-quality education to schools and homes worldwide.<br><br></em><em>Join us in our commitment to transforming education and empowering communities worldwide.<br><br></em>https://www.faria.org/careers

title: SVP Engineering
description: <p>The Senior Vice President (SVP) of Engineering is a pivotal executive role, reporting into our Chief Technology &amp; Product Officer. The role is responsible for leading the globally distributed engineering organisations through a dual transformation: evolving the business from an academic publisher to a Knowledge Marketplace, while simultaneously pivoting the technology function toward AI-First Software Engineering.</p><p><br></p><p>This role requires a leader who is a strategist, an expert in modern engineering, and is aware of how to embed AI across the entire software lifecycle. You will be responsible for the technology strategy that powers our marketplace, balancing the need for robust distributed systems with the agility required to experiment and grow. You will partner closely with Product leadership to co-create solutions that solve complex user problems.</p><p><br></p><p>The role will work to bridge geographies and time zones, championing Distributed Agile practices that allow our global teams to collaborate seamlessly. You will embed AI-assisted development (e.g., Copilot, code generation, automated refactoring) into the core of our SDLC, amplifying the productivity of our global teams and defining the future of our engineering workforce. You will champion Distributed Agile practices that bridge time zones and instil a culture of technical excellence rooted in Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Continuous Delivery. This role demands a visionary leader who can balance technical innovation with business priorities to achieve sustainable growth and competitive advantage.</p><p><br></p><p>The Academic Publishing industry and T&amp;F are on an exciting growth agenda; from a portfolio of separate products to an integrated platform with a focus on leveraging emerging technologies to ensure advanced substantiated knowledge is accessible and can have real world impact. This role ensures that the company achieves its long-term goals and remains competitive in a dynamic business environment.</p><p><br></p><p><strong><u>Key Responsibilities and Accountability: </u></strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Technology Strategy &amp; Architecture</strong></p><ul><li>Define and execute a scalable engineering strategy to transition the business to a platform model, leveraging modern architectures like Event-Driven Architecture and Microservices.</li><li>Ensure systems support high-traffic marketplace scalability, balancing speed-to-market with long-term differentiation.</li><li>Build strong relationships with stakeholders, translating business vision into technical delivery while effectively communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Modern Engineering Excellence</strong></p><ul><li>Embed AI-first engineering practices to enhance developer productivity and ensure secure, high-quality AI-generated code.</li><li>Drive Continuous Delivery and DevOps maturity using DORA metrics to achieve high-velocity, high-quality outputs.</li><li>Modernize legacy systems by migrating to cloud-native architectures without disrupting business operations.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Product Engineering Partnership</strong></p><ul><li>Collaborate with Product leadership to align engineering with product discovery and commercial outcomes.</li><li>Shorten feedback loops to enable rapid testing and iteration, ensuring technical decisions enhance marketplace performance and customer satisfaction.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Team Development &amp; Culture</strong></p><ul><li>Build a cohesive, high-performing engineering team, fostering ownership, inclusivity, and continuous learning.</li><li>Lead AI upskilling programs and attract top-tier talent in modern stacks, distributed systems, and AI engineering.</li><li>Promote diversity, equity, and inclusion while mentoring leaders to balance technical expertise with people management.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Stakeholder Collaboration</strong></p><ul><li>Act as a liaison between engineering and other departments, ensuring alignment across the organization.</li><li>Represent engineering in executive meetings and external engagements, providing strategic insights and recommendations.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Creativity &amp; Technology Leadership</strong></p><ul><li>Champion emerging technologies and foster a culture of experimentation to maintain a competitive edge.</li><li>Identify industry trends and opportunities to inform strategic decisions and align with customer aspirations.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Experience &amp; Knowledge </strong></p><p><br></p><ul><li>Modern Engineering Practitioner: Proven deep, hands-on background in software engineering with a philosophy rooted in TDD, CI/CD, and Agile XP (Extreme Programming) principles. Understanding of "good" software and solutions. Crucially, you have practical experience of AI tools and understand the impact this has on productivity and crucially on code quality.</li><li>Distributed Systems: Proven experience architecting and managing complex Distributed Systems and Cloud-Native architectures (AWS/Azure/GCP). You understand the complexities of building a multi-sided global marketplace.</li><li>Marketplace/Platform Context: Experience building platforms that support B2B or B2C marketplaces, or complex content ecosystems, is highly desirable.</li><li>Global Leadership: Experience leading large-scale, globally distributed engineering teams. You have a playbook for managing distributed agile at scale, handling cultural nuances, and synchronizing delivery across time zones.</li><li>Strategic Transformation: Demonstrated history of leading engineering teams through transformations from legacy methods to modern, automated, and AI-enhanced workflows.</li><li>Product Fluency: You speak "Product." You have experience working in a "Triad" model (Engineering, Product, Delivery) and understand how to balance technical debt reduction with feature delivery.</li><li>Holistic business knowledge with an understanding of the operational complexities of large multinational organisations particularly of a matrix organisational structure.</li><li>Mature and proactive attitude, with excellent judgment and problem-solving skills</li><li>A flexible and agile mentality able to quickly adapt and respond to changing work pressures and prioritises</li><li>Excellent communication and influencing skills with the ability to present and drive change with stakeholders at all levels of the business.</li><li>A curious outlook – known for asking the right questions of the right stakeholders.</li><li>Highly collaborative, emotionally intelligent and someone people are excited to work with; also having strong personal influencing skills</li><li>Extremely well organised and comfortable managing a significant and varied workload across global time zones that needs constant prioritisation.</li><li>Numerate with an ability to interpret and understand project plans, budgets, and financial targets; Ability to analyse and compile a large amount of data and come up with conclusive results</li><li>Commercially minded with strong financial acumen and a dedicated customer focussed attitude</li><li>Demonstrated commercial acumen and results orientation.</li><li>Programme management skills with a proven ability to get things done, not deterred by the changing or evolving nature of a project.</li></ul><p><br></p><p>We ask that candidates live within a reasonable commuting distance of our office in either Milton Park Oxfordshire (OX14) or London Blackfriars to enable you to <strong><u>collaborate in person at least 3 days per week.</u></strong></p><p><br></p><p>Taylor &amp; Francis is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you have a disability, or face another barrier, and would like to request an adjustment to assist your participation in the hiring process and/or in the advertised position, please contact recruitment@tandf.co.uk. Your request will be reviewed and considered in the strictest confidence.</p>

title: Director of Platform Engineering
description: <p><strong>Director of Platform Engineering | Fintech | London Hybrid</strong></p><p><br></p><p>A global fintech who's technology powers eading e-commerce, payments, and tech brands is looking for a <strong>Director of Platform Engineering</strong> to help drive the next stage of platform and team maturity.</p><p><br></p><p>This role sits at the intersection of <strong>technical depth</strong> and <strong>hands-on leadership</strong>, with a blend of:</p><p>Strong engineering foundations across high-performance platforms, microservices, API-driven development, and distributed systems.</p><p>AND</p><p>Leading and developing teams. You’ll shape the structure, strengthen collaboration, and support a high-performance culture.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p><ul><li>Evolving cloud-native infrastructure that’s secure, scalable, and resilient.</li><li>Ensuring the Platform Team adds maximum value across the breadth of the business. </li><li>Helping shape an engineering culture focused on clarity, velocity, and collaboration.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p><ul><li>Solid cloud and platform engineering experience (AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC).</li><li>Proven leadership within platform or infrastructure teams.</li><li>A strategic approach to scaling systems in complex environments.</li><li>Experience in high-growth, product-led businesses (fintech helpful but not essential).</li></ul><p></p>

title: Engineering Director
description: <strong>Company Description<br><br></strong>Wise is one the fastest growing companies in Europe and we’re on a mission: to make money without borders the new normal. We’ve got 15 million customers across the globe and we’re growing. Fast.<br><br>Current banking systems don’t let us send, spend or receive money across borders easily. Or quickly. Or cheaply.<br><br>So, we’re building a new one.<br><br>Enter: our Global Product Tribe!<br><br><strong>Job Description<br><br></strong>The Global Product tribe at Wise owns nearly all aspects of the customer experience and core infrastructure powering the Wise Account, Wise Business, and Remittances (Transfer) products. We’re on a mission to build the world’s most global account—one that offers a truly local experience no matter where life or business takes our customers.<br><br>If you’ve used Wise, there’s a good chance you’ve spent 90% of your time engaging with products and experiences developed by teams in this tribe.<br><br>The tribe is organized into six key squads: Onboarding, Send, Receive, Spend, Account, and Grow—each responsible for a specific area of the product journey.<br><br>We’re looking for an inspiring and customer-obsessed engineering leader to join us—someone with a bias for action, a strong product mindset, and a passion for world-class user experiences. You’ll start by leading our Receive Squad, with the opportunity to grow your scope across more of the Global Product organization in the future.<br><br><strong>About The Receive Squad<br><br></strong>The Receive Squad builds the products that allow Wise customers to get paid from anywhere in the world and fund their accounts and transactions. Our goal is to offer the fastest, most transparent, most convenient, and fairly priced ways for customers to receive money globally.<br><br>Today, we provide local account details in 10+ countries, and our PayIn platform processes over £200 billion annually in incoming payments. We're also laying the foundation for payment facilitation capabilities to support merchants and global businesses. As the world becomes more interconnected, our customers increasingly rely on Wise to handle all their payment needs through a single global account.<br><br><strong>What You’ll Do<br><br></strong><ul><li>Drive the technical and product direction for engineering teams within the Receive Squad, aligning closely with product and design leads to build customer-first solutions.</li><li>Be hands-on when needed—with a strong eye for system design, you’ll dive into technical details to help teams make smart architectural decisions and unblock complex challenges.</li><li>Build and scale high-performing engineering teams that can support Wise’s continued hypergrowth and complex global operations.</li><li>Unblock teams and enable them to move faster in an increasingly large and complex global organization by reducing inefficiencies, cutting unnecessary admin, and improving team focus.</li><li>Navigate risk, compliance, and regulatory challenges while maintaining agility—working iteratively to release product improvements without compromising safety or speed.</li><li>Collaborate closely with neighbouring tribes—including Regional (local payment schemes, regulators, tailoring product to local needs), Finance &amp; Treasury (safeguarding, liquidity management, accounting &amp; reporting), and Servicing (Financial Crime, KYC, and account monitoring)—to ensure alignment across Wise’s global platform.</li><li>Influence and align with Wise’s broader technical and product vision across squads and tribes.</li><li>Mentor engineering managers and technical leads, and create the conditions for autonomous, empowered teams to thrive.</li><li>Champion a healthy engineering culture rooted in continuous improvement, technical excellence, and customer-centricity.<br><br></li></ul><strong>What’s In It For You<br><br></strong><ul><li>A chance to lead the teams building the core infrastructure powering a global financial platform used by millions.</li><li>The opportunity to shape Wise’s global account experience as we scale to serve more regions, more use cases, and more complexity.</li><li>A key role in navigating the intersection of tech, regulation, finance, and customer experience, working across Wise’s most critical domains.</li><li>The ability to make a tangible difference by simplifying internal operations and accelerating delivery—enabling your teams to do their best work.</li><li>A collaborative, no-blame culture built on transparency, ownership, and trust.</li><li>The autonomy to build and scale teams your way—supported by strong peers and leadership who care deeply about impact and people.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>You’re an experienced engineering leader who has led complex, high-impact teams at scale.</li><li>You care deeply about building products that solve real customer problems—and you bring that empathy into how you lead and prioritize.</li><li>You bring a strong technical foundation, with a solid eye for system design, architecture, and scalability, and you’re not afraid to roll up your sleeves and go deep when teams need help.</li><li>You’ve worked in or with regulated industries and know how to balance compliance, speed, and customer value.</li><li>You’re energized by removing blockers, simplifying processes, and enabling teams to ship faster.</li><li>You’re comfortable leading in a globally distributed, cross-functional environment and collaborating across a diverse set of teams.</li><li>You thrive in a high-growth, high-accountability culture where autonomy and trust go hand in hand.<br><br></li></ul>Additional Information<br><br>For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.<br><br>We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.<br><br>Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.<br><br>If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.<br><br>Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Head of Engineering
description: <p>We're looking for a Head of Engineering to lead one of our cross-functional engineering clusters, driving technical excellence and helping to build the platform that powers Yoto's mission to be the soundtrack of childhood.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>About Yoto</strong></p><p>Yoto is a screen-free interactive audio platform for kids. We make carefully connected audio players that kids control, with no microphones, cameras or ads. We have a catalogue of audio that inspires creative play and learning with 1,000+ titles in our card store from top creators, publishers and labels - think Disney, Marvel, Roald Dahl and Universal Music. We also create Yoto Originals like this one.</p><ul><li>Voted the 14th fastest-growing private software technology company in Britain in The Sunday Times 100 Tech 2025; and named the 94th fastest-growing company in Europe in the prestigious FT1000.</li><li>Ranked 9th in Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies in 2024; and featured in the Sifted 100 fastest-growing startups across the UK&amp;I by revenue growth.</li><li>Featured in Bloomberg’s 25 UK startups to watch in 2023; and ranked second fastest growing tech company in the UK in the Deloitte Fast50.</li><li>Named one of TIME Magazine’s Top 100 Inventions of 2020.</li><li>We’re over 200 employees spread across the world.. and growing!</li></ul><p>We’re on a mission to be the soundtrack of childhood, and help families on their own unique adventures. By creating products that inspire independent play, we help families discover and grow with an inspiring world of audio - and we would like you to help us achieve it!</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Yoto’s Engineering Team</strong></p><p>At Yoto, our Engineering organisation is structured into mission-driven clusters, each made up of cross-functional teams that include engineering, product, design, and other key disciplines. These clusters focus on different areas of our platform and products to help us move faster, stay aligned, and build with purpose.</p><p>This role reports directly to the VP of Engineering where you’ll form part of the senior engineering leadership team alongside the other Heads of Engineering, CTO and senior IC leads.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong>:</p><ul><li>Lead multiple cross functional engineering teams within the Family Experience cluster consisting of ~20 engineers (FE, BE, mobile, QA) and managers.</li><li>Partner with Product, Design, and Commercial teams to continuously improve the user experience, performance, conversion and retention of our global store</li><li>Champion engineering excellence across the cluster - from clean architecture and automated testing to observability, security, accessibility, etc</li><li>Foster an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing engineering culture</li><li>Coach your manager-level reports to strengthen their leadership and help them unlock the full potential of their teams</li><li>Mentor and support individuals across the Family Experience cluster to help them grow and succeed in their roles</li><li>Promote Yoto Engineering within the tech community; grow the team by continuing to hire top talent.</li><li>Manage relationships and negotiate with key external partners and vendors</li><li>Oversee the alignment on technical direction of our eCommerce architecture set by lead engineers</li><li>Champion the opportunities and guide through challenges of entering the era of AI-powered coding</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>What you’ll bring:</strong></p><ul><li>Proven ability to lead teams of managers and senior engineers across different specialisms</li><li>Deep technical full-stack expertise in web and mobile platforms (headless architecture, CMS, checkout systems - Shopify or similar)</li><li>Strong understanding of systems design, scaling strategies, and performance optimisation</li><li>Excellent stakeholder management skills and a collaborative approach to problem solving</li><li>A user-first mindset and passion for building smooth digital experiences</li><li>Excellent understanding of programming and SW development paradigms and best practices, up-to-date with latest technologies and frameworks</li><li>Nice to have: Experience with international eCommerce, subscription models, or digital merchandising tools</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Salary:</strong> £110,000 - £130,000 based on experience</p><p><br></p><p><strong>What you can expect from Yoto:</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Flexibility: </strong>Hybrid working - expectation of 1 day a week on average, but you are welcome to come in more than this. How you meet the minimum expectation is up to you, to ensure you're happy and productive in your role whilst also getting that vital face time with your colleagues. Take advantage of our ‘work from anywhere’ policy to work from a different location for up to 6 weeks every year. Summer Hours policy to use between the months of June and August.</li><li><strong>Financial: </strong>Generous share option programme so you’ll be invested in Yoto’s success. Receive Income Protection, covering long term sickness for up to 2 years and company sick pay that increases with length of service. Life Assurance cover from day one of your service. Workplace Pension offering up to to 3% employer contributions, following probation. Generous employee referral bonus scheme.</li><li><strong>Health &amp; Wellness:</strong> Private Medical Insurance via Aviva, or a Wellbeing Allowance to be used for memberships, subscriptions, treatment or therapy. Access to 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) through WeCare and unlimited access to Dental advice and guidance via Toothfairy. Bike to work scheme to promote healthier lifestyles.</li><li><strong>Time Off:</strong> 25 days of holiday per year, plus bank holidays. On top of this, you also receive your birthday off, plus 1 extra day of holiday for every year worked after you hit your 2 year anniversary, up to 5 extra days. After 4 years of service, you are also eligible for our sabbatical policy offering up to 3 months' of unpaid sabbatical.</li><li><strong>Helping Families:</strong> Variety of family-friendly leave, including enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption, fertility, pregnancy loss and carers leave. Unlock savings with our workplace nursery scheme, designed to support parents of preschool-aged children.</li><li><strong>People &amp; Planet:</strong> Up to 2 volunteer days a year. A Book Allowance of up to £50 a year to contribute to your professional development.</li><li><strong>Fun Perks:</strong> You receive your very own Yoto player and starter pack of cards! Regular company socials and celebrations, including our annual YotoFest!</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Equity and Diversity</strong></p><p>At Yoto, we love creating a world where childhood is rich with discovery and joy. We’re also passionate about building a workplace where everyone can thrive - both professionally and personally. We value flexibility and give our team the freedom to balance life and work in ways that suit them.</p><p>We're committed to fostering a safe, diverse, and inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of their background, feel valued and supported. Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion group holds bi-monthly forums to elevate diverse voices and perspectives, ensuring everyone at Yoto feels heard, respected, and appreciated.</p><p>We don’t just embrace differences - we celebrate them. We share audio content from a vibrant and diverse community of creators (check out our DEI selection), and we are building a team that reflects that same diversity. We invite candidates from all walks of life to explore opportunities with us and join a company that champions flexibility, equity, and inclusion. Take a look at our website for more information on our approach to People and Planet.</p><p><br></p><p>Please only apply or engage with Yoto jobs posted on our careers page (careers.yotoplay.com or careers.yotoplay.com/en). All correspondence from our Talent team will only come through Teamtailor, our application tracking system.</p>

title: Vice President, Marketing
description: <strong>Who are we?<br><br></strong>Our mission is to scale intelligence to serve humanity. We’re training and deploying frontier models for developers and enterprises who are building AI systems to power magical experiences like content generation, semantic search, RAG, and agents. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI.<br><br>We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. We like to work hard and move fast to do what’s best for our customers.<br><br>Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are passionate about their craft. Each person is one of the best in the world at what they do. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives is a requirement for building great products.<br><br>Join us on our mission and shape the future!<br><br><strong>Why this role?<br><br></strong>Generative AI represents a turning point for businesses in every industry. Cohere is at the center of enterprise transformation and is laser focused on serving the Enterprise sector, and its developers and partners.<br><br>The Marketing organization is pivotal to the growth and success of Cohere - positioning and communicating Cohere’s unique offerings to a unique field of developers, enterprise AI &amp; tech leadership, C-Suite executives, ML researchers, consultants, bankers, partners driving technology &amp; workflow change within enterprises (SIs, cloud providers, SaaS providers), policymakers, and public-sector influencers.<br><br>The VP Marketing will proactively set direction for Cohere in the marketplace, leading our positioning with the broad range of audiences listed above, driving product marketing, partner activation &amp; enablement, developer relations, brand, social, digital, LLM University, certification/training programs and more. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to establish and scale a generational company in a most transformational time and sector.<br><br><strong>As Our VP Marketing You Will<br><br></strong><ul><li>Lead our Marketing organization and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (i.e. Product, Revenue / Sales, Machine Learning, Engineering) to ensure alignment on both 1) Enterprise &amp; 2) Product-led growth Go-to-Market efforts &amp; strategy.</li><li>Develop, direct, and evaluate effective marketing programs using market research, product marketing, competitive intelligence, marketing communications, and public/policy relations.</li><li>Develop a measurement strategy, objectives, KPIs, forecasting, benchmarks, and dashboards to measure the effectiveness of marketing programs, ensuring continuous improvement and optimization.</li><li>Drive the company's brand strategy, including brand positioning, messaging, and identity to build a strong presence in the market.</li><li>Align global marketing strategy to develop and implement campaigns that drive growth with enterprise customer target segments and partners (i.e. cloud service providers, GSIs and management consulting firms).</li><li>Collaborate with our growing list of enterprise partners and customers to raise awareness and drive market adoption.</li><li>Expand our leading education capability (LLMU) that enables developers and partners to deploy Cohere’s technology within their organizations, positions Cohere as the premier LLM provider to work with, and enables exponential growth through partners.</li><li>Build and cultivate relationships with industry influencers, media partners, and stakeholders.</li><li>Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging marketing technologies, proactively providing input into strategy, product and technical decisions.<br><br></li></ul><strong>You may be a good fit for this career opportunity, if you have:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Proven experience as a senior Marketing leader across multiple functions (developer relations, enterprise, brand, growth).</li><li>15+ years of senior level experience developing and achieving successful marketing strategies for both 1) Product-led growth and 2) Enterprise SaaS/B2B software or software-related company driving Enterprise Go-to-Market motions.</li><li>A relevant degree in Marketing/Business/Engineering/CS.</li><li>A deep understanding of the changing market dynamics in the AI industry is an advantage.</li><li>Proven track record of successfully launching and directing marketing efforts supporting cutting edge products, and developing effective marketing strategies and business plans.</li><li>Familiarity with partner ecosystems, and enabling partner channels to deploy at scale (GSIs, consultancies, SaaS leaders, hyperscalers)</li><li>Demonstrated experience building, guiding and inspiring a team as a servant leader</li><li>International/global experience and familiarity is preferred<br><br></li></ul>If some of the above doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply!<br><br>We value and celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment for all. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.<br><br><strong>Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks<br><br></strong>🤝 An open and inclusive culture and work environment<br><br>🧑💻 Work closely with a team on the cutting edge of AI research<br><br>🍽 Weekly lunch stipend, in-office lunches &amp; snacks<br><br>🦷 Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget to take care of your mental health<br><br>🐣 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months<br><br>🎨 Personal enrichment benefits towards arts and culture, fitness and well-being, quality time, and workspace improvement<br><br>🏙 Remote-flexible, offices in Toronto, New York, San Francisco, London and Paris, as well as a co-working stipend<br><br>✈️ 6 weeks of vacation (30 working days!)

title: Director of Finance, Engineering - London Stock Exchange Group
description: We are looking for a director of strategic programmes to join our Engineering finance team . Across Engineering, we have launched a number of transformational initiatives. We are going to upgrade our global real-time infrastructure. This super-low latency infrastructure supports our clients, and enables us to deliver instant data to support traders around the world. We are migrating hundreds of applications into the Microsoft Azure Cloud.<br><br>And we have a couple of big challenges ahead. We need to better understand what applications will ultimately move to the cloud, and what we need to keep on our own servers in dedicated datacentres. We need to understand how to commercially optimise this equation - and not just for Engineering, but end-to-end for the firm. And we need to become more efficient. In our migrations. In our delivery. And in how we deliver support.<br><br>The director will lead a team of two experienced finance managers and work directly with a large number of people across the firm. The programme managers of these initiatives, the software development teams, the infrastructure delivery teams and of course other finance teams.<br><br>We are looking for someone who meets a number of the descriptions below - but you don't need to meet all of these to apply for the job. We rate talent over having done this exact thing" before and don't mind investing the time to help get you up to speed.<br><br><ul><li>Finance partnering - You have partnered senior leaders in the business before on planning, forecasting and delivery to target on annual budgets of £200m+</li><li>Complexity - You are able to break down complex problems to make them sound simple, even if they're a bit fuzzy</li><li>Detail oriented - You're in the detail, you love a good Excel (or Python, PowerBI, or your tool of choice).</li><li>Structured - You bring structure and help your business to stay on top</li><li>Engineering &amp; Cloud - You already have experience with cloud migrations, or are interested to learn a lot in a short period of time<br><br><br></li></ul>LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.<br><br>Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of <strong> Integrity, Partnership </strong>, <strong> Excellence </strong> and <strong> Change </strong> underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.<br><br>Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce. You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas and are committed to sustainability across our global business. You will experience the critical role we have in helping to re-engineer the financial ecosystem to support and drive sustainable economic growth. Together, we are aiming to achieve this growth by accelerating the just transition to net zero, enabling growth of the green economy and creating inclusive economic opportunity.<br><br>LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.<br><br>We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone's race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.<br><br>Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it's used for, and how it's obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject .<br><br>If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.<br><br>
